purpose: Explain FP8 versus BF16 costs using the current final production build; no kernel changes.
notes: All runs use qwen35b, EP2, E256, top8, 5 warmups, 20 samples, BF16 dW; matching workload hashes checked within each token count.
Wall runs are stream ordered. Diagnostic runs omit --stream-ordered and set WEFTMOE_BACKWARD_PROGRESS=1; phase timestamps are device globaltimer nanoseconds.
Dgrad interval includes dispatch, dU, SwiGLU, FP8 cache construction and dX; it is not pure dX GEMM.
Wgrad interval begins after cache preparation; individual dW1 and dW2 tasks can overlap. Its saving excludes cache preparation cost paid by forward/Dgrad.
Medians of independent runs/phases are not additive and cannot exactly reconstruct cycle latency.
FP8 weights are prepared outside timing; default BF16 packs weights per forward. Prepared BF16 forward controls are provided separately.
Optimizer and weight preparation after updates are excluded.
